svg.aria-label: Environment-similarity matrix: 33 environments by 33, each off-diagonal cell filled on a diverging scale by Kendall's tau-b between the two environments' columns of within-environment standardized score over the models measured on both (red is disagreement, blue is agreement, near-white is zero). Rows and columns follow the shared environment order (taxonomy cell, then provider, then name; 5 taxonomy cells in contiguous runs). 528 of 528 pairs reach the gate of 10 shared models; a pair under it is hatched, and the diagonal is blank. The only legend is a vertical colour bar from +1 (top) to −1 (bottom). E1's registered level0 atlas; no per-cell reporting-level atlas exists in the E1 pack, so the matrix is drawn from the level0 z.
